title: Escape Room USA
specs: Seven unique adventures with over 3 rooms each on average
Authentic props and high-quality custom puzzles
Named one of the top ten escape rooms in the country
Children under 18 must have a parent or legal guardian sign liability waiver
Guests aged 14 and under must have an adult (18+) participate with them
Guests 2 years and older require a ticket; under 2 may accompany if worn on body
Private experiences; no sharing with other guests outside your party
Accommodates large and small groups and special events
includes: All game materials and puzzles provided
Monitoring by staff during the game
Walkie-talkie or in-room microphone to contact Adventure Guide
blurb: Guests are locked in themed rooms and must solve puzzles and locate clues to escape within 60 minutes. The experience is private to each group and monitored by staff with emergency exit options. The venue includes a lounge area for gathering before or after the game.
extraNote: All Escape Room Adventures are private experiences · Emergency exit button available; exit allowed anytime for emergencies · Minimum 48 hours notice required to reschedule in emergencies · No refunds once booking is confirmed; all sales are final · You must leave the room immediately after 60 minutes; no extensions
